//: Vercel serves the pre-built static site, not the Express app.
Running the server here does not work the way it looks like it does: a
serverless function is frozen once it has replied, so the scheduler's
timer never fires, and its filesystem does not survive a cold start, so
the feed and any push subscriptions are lost and every cold start
re-scrapes all four government sites from scratch.
Instead the scheduled GitHub Actions run does the scraping and commits
the feed to site-data/, which pushes here and triggers this build. The
site is then plain static files: no cold starts, no re-scraping, and the
same feed the alerts were sent from.
